title: Application timeout during peak hours
description: Users are reporting 504 Gateway Timeout errors when attempting to save records in the CRM during mid-morning. It is unclear if the SQL query is hanging or if the load balancer is dropping packets.
resolution: Optimized long-running query and verified bandwidth saturation on the application server NIC.

title: Intermittent connectivity to remote SQL instance
description: Clients lose connection to the production database randomly. Logs show connection reset errors, but ping remains stable.
resolution: Replaced faulty switch port causing packet drops during high-throughput database synchronization.

title: Slow data retrieval for dashboard
description: Dashboard takes 30+ seconds to load. We aren't sure if the network latency is high between the app server and DB, or if an index is missing.
resolution: Added missing non-clustered index on the primary table to reduce read time.

title: Application 'Connection Refused' error
description: The application cannot reach the database server. Testing shows the server is up, but the port is unreachable from the app tier.
resolution: Updated firewall rules that were inadvertently flushed during a security appliance patch.

title: Deadlock errors increasing in frequency
description: Users report records failing to update. Is this a network partition causing retry loops, or inefficient transaction locking in the DB?
resolution: Refactored application transaction logic to minimize lock duration on shared rows.

title: High latency on API endpoints
description: API responses are lagging. Could be high network congestion or the database taking too long to write to the transaction log.
resolution: Identified broadcast storm on the subnet and implemented VLAN segmentation.

title: Data synchronization failures
description: Remote branch offices are failing to sync with central SQL server. Could be a VPN tunnel issue or DB lock contention.
resolution: Increased MTU size settings on the VPN tunnel to prevent packet fragmentation.

title: Unexpected session termination
description: Active database sessions are dropping without error codes. Unclear if the idle timeout setting in the DB is active or if a NAT device is dropping the stateful connection.
resolution: Adjusted firewall TCP keep-alive settings to prevent premature connection reaping.

title: Degraded performance on bulk uploads
description: Bulk import jobs are failing halfway through. Could be a network buffer overflow or disk I/O wait on the database.
resolution: Expanded database transaction log storage to prevent disk-full stalls during large imports.

title: Authentication service unreachable
description: Users cannot login. The authentication service is failing to connect to the User DB. Is the database down or is the network link to the DB cluster severed?
resolution: Restored DNS resolution for the database cluster load balancer.

title: Account locked after failed login attempts
description: User is unable to access the system and is receiving an 'Account Locked' message. Unknown if this is due to a password rotation policy or a potential brute-force attack.
resolution: Verify user identity, unlock account, and inspect sign-in logs for suspicious origin IPs.

title: User cannot access internal file share
description: User reports 'Access Denied' when trying to reach a departmental folder. It is unclear if their permissions were revoked during the recent security audit or if the folder permissions were incorrectly migrated.
resolution: Audit Group Policy Object (GPO) memberships and verify folder NTFS permissions.

title: Unexpected session termination
description: User is being logged out of the ERP system intermittently. Could be a session timeout policy configuration or a security feature detecting concurrent login sessions from different devices.
resolution: Review session timeout settings and investigate logs for unauthorized concurrent login detection.

title: VPN connection failing with 'Authentication Error'
description: User cannot connect to VPN. System displays generic error. Root cause could be an expired certificate or a blocked account status due to suspected compromise.
resolution: Renew security certificate and verify account status against active threats.

title: Email account sending suspicious bounce-backs
description: User says they are getting delivery failure notifications for emails they never sent. Could be a misconfigured automated script or an account takeover.
resolution: Reset credentials, check for unauthorized forwarding rules, and update SPF/DKIM records.

title: Software launch blocked by system
description: User cannot run a specific productivity tool. Could be a lack of administrative permissions to execute or an Application Whitelisting/Endpoint protection block.
resolution: Verify user rights and check endpoint protection logs for blocked execution signatures.

title: Password reset link not working
description: User reports the reset link leads to a 403 Forbidden page. Could be an expired link or a triggered security block on the user's IP due to repeated invalid requests.
resolution: Clear browser cache and verify if the user's IP is on the security blocklist.

title: New hire missing folder permissions
description: User joined the company but cannot see folders they require. Could be an AD group membership delay or a security restriction preventing new accounts from accessing sensitive zones.
resolution: Update Active Directory group memberships and apply relevant security clearance tags.

title: External partner account access issues
description: Contractor cannot access the portal. Could be their account has reached the end of its life cycle (Access) or they have failed MFA validation (Security).
resolution: Validate account expiration date and re-sync MFA hardware token.

title: System slow and unresponsive after login
description: User reports high latency immediately upon logging in. Could be an overloaded SSO authentication server or a deep-packet inspection process scanning traffic upon entry.
resolution: Analyze login logs to identify bottlenecks in the identity provider or security scanning suite.

title: Intermittent file access timeouts
description: Users are reporting sporadic 30-second delays when opening files from the shared network drive. The issue seems to impact different departments at random intervals.
resolution: Upgraded core network switches to resolve intermittent packet loss causing SMB session timeouts.

title: Latency spikes during high-traffic periods
description: System performance degrades significantly every Monday morning during the weekly backup sync. Operations team cannot determine if it is a bandwidth or disk throughput issue.
resolution: Reconfigured storage array caching policies to prevent IOPS saturation during high-load backup windows.

title: VMs entering 'Read Only' mode
description: Several virtual machines have suddenly locked up and are reporting file system errors. Guest OS logs are inconclusive regarding the root cause.
resolution: Identified a corrupted SAN controller firmware causing intermittent write-access drops to the VMFS datastore.

title: Database connection reset errors
description: Application logs show persistent 'Connection Reset' errors. Database administrators suspect network instability, while network admins suspect disk-bound database hangs.
resolution: Replaced a faulty SFP module on the top-of-rack switch that was causing micro-outages for the database cluster.

title: Unexpected 'Disk Busy' alerts
description: Monitoring tools show 100% disk utilization across multiple servers. It is unclear if a malicious process is hitting the disks or if network congestion is causing queue backups.
resolution: Expanded storage pool capacity and rebalanced LUN distribution to alleviate disk I/O contention.

title: Slow directory enumeration
description: Browsing large file directories on the central server takes several minutes. The server CPU usage is low, but responsiveness is abysmal.
resolution: Optimized DNS round-robin settings and updated NIC drivers to improve path negotiation speed.

title: Application failure during heavy I/O tasks
description: Custom accounting software crashes whenever large reports are generated. The error message is generic 'IO Exception'.
resolution: Resolved storage array controller latency by migrating high-I/O volumes to SSD-tier storage tiers.

title: Mount point mounting failure
description: Several application servers are failing to mount their remote drives after a reboot. Troubleshooting has been unable to verify if it is an authentication (Network) or target availability (Storage) issue.
resolution: Corrected an incorrect VLAN tagging configuration on the switch port preventing storage-to-server traffic.

title: File corruption reported on legacy share
description: Users are reporting that some files contain gibberish when opened. Engineers are debating whether this is a network transmission error or failing storage sectors.
resolution: Replaced failing hard disks in the RAID 6 array that were causing silent data corruption.

title: High packet retransmission rates
description: Network dashboard shows high retransmission on the storage VLAN. It is unclear if the storage array is overloaded or the physical cabling is compromised.
resolution: Identified and replaced a damaged Cat6a patch cable causing physical layer signal degradation.

title: Intermittent timeouts when accessing the CRM portal
description: Users are reporting that the CRM application frequently hangs or times out after 10-15 seconds of inactivity. It is unclear if the web server is struggling or if there is packet loss.
resolution: Increased keep-alive timeout on the load balancer to prevent premature session termination.

title: Slow file save operations on shared drive
description: Users report that saving large documents to the network drive takes a long time, often resulting in an 'Application Not Responding' error.
resolution: Identified a congested network switch port; moved the file server uplink to a dedicated gigabit port.

title: Database connection errors during peak hours
description: The accounting software returns 'Unable to connect to database' at random intervals, primarily between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM.
resolution: Optimized database connection pooling settings to prevent exhaustion of available application handles.

title: ERP module fails to load dashboard widgets
description: Dashboard widgets in the ERP remain stuck on the loading spinner. Users can browse other parts of the site without issue.
resolution: Cleared corrupted server-side cache files that were causing the widget API calls to fail.

title: Users disconnected from remote desktop application
description: Remote staff are being kicked out of the virtual desktop environment with a 'Connection Lost' error.
resolution: Adjusted firewall session timeouts that were terminating idle VDI connections prematurely.

title: Email client freezes when synchronizing large mailboxes
description: Outlook becomes unresponsive for several minutes periodically. Possible cause is synchronization delay or high latency to the mail server.
resolution: Reduced the local OST file size and disabled background indexing to prevent client-side hangs.

title: Error 504 Gateway Timeout on reporting tool
description: Running the month-end report results in a 504 error. Could be a server timeout or a network proxy intercepting the long request.
resolution: Increased the execution time limit in the application configuration to accommodate long-running SQL queries.

title: Application sluggishness for remote workers
description: The web application is fast in the office but unusable from VPN. Difficult to distinguish between poor VPN bandwidth and application design flaws.
resolution: Implemented split-tunneling on the VPN to reduce latency for the application's traffic.

title: Frequent authentication failures on web portal
description: Users are randomly logged out or prompted for credentials multiple times. Could be a session cookie issue or an intermittent authentication server connectivity issue.
resolution: Synchronized time across domain controllers to fix Kerberos token validation failures.

title: Print jobs stuck in spooler
description: The ERP system sends print jobs that never arrive at the network printer. The spooler shows 'Error' status.
resolution: Updated printer firmware and corrected a routing issue that was blocking the print server's access to the printer's IP.
